stem.text: Compound X is treated with two reagents successively, forming compound Z.

stem.alt: Reaction scheme: compound X, a cyclohexene ring bearing a CHO group and a COCH3 group, is treated with a mild oxidising agent to give Y; Y is then treated with NaBH4 to give Z.

A.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclohexene ring bearing a CO2H group and a CH(OH)CH3 group.

B.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclohexene ring bearing a CH2OH group and a CH(OH)CH3 group.

C.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclohexane ring bearing a CH2OH group and a CH(OH)CH3 group.

D.alt: Skeletal formula: a cyclohexane ring bearing a CO2H group and a CH(OH)CH3 group.
